description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kausigamuwa, Rideegama D/S/Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No.420066 (24/0493)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including detailed property descriptions, ownership details, and legal status of the properties. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements.
